_help: permission name -> the EXACT plugin ids allowed to use it (no globs). Default-DENY: a plugin that declares a permission but is not listed here still loads, with every capability that permission gates degraded. e.g. "engine:calls": ["@me/burn"]. One exception: plugins:manage (sm plugins install/update/remove/outdated) defaults to ["@s2script/basecommands"] when this file does not list it; set it to [] to turn those commands off.
